_comment: Delegation modes. 'instruction' is what Claude is told at session start; only 'off' is enforced by the server (gemini_delegate and gemini_analyze refuse). Shared by server.py and server.mjs.

off.description: Gemini disabled: the delegation tools refuse to run. For repos whose code must not be sent to Google.
off.instruction: Gemini delegation is OFF here: gemini_delegate and gemini_analyze will refuse. Work as usual without them.

manual.description: Delegate only when the user asks (in the conversation, with a /capocantiere command, or in CLAUDE.md).
manual.instruction: Delegate to Gemini only when the user explicitly asks for it (in the conversation, with a /capocantiere command, or in CLAUDE.md). Otherwise work as usual.

auto.description: Claude decides case by case whether Gemini, itself or a Claude subagent fits best.
auto.instruction: Delegate to Gemini when it clearly fits (see the gemini-delegation skill); otherwise do the work yourself or use a Claude subagent. Explicit user instructions and CLAUDE.md take precedence.

prefer.description: Delegate everything that makes sense to delegate; Claude keeps design, delicate parts, review and verification.
prefer.instruction: Actively look for work to delegate to Gemini (gemini_delegate for code, gemini_analyze for exploring) and keep design, delicate parts, review and verification for yourself. Explicit user instructions and CLAUDE.md take precedence.
